title: Anyone dream here?
content: I have dreams in a huge house where melt of the rooms look like this. All carpeted, all beige. Some rooms are darker and some have more natural lighting. There are usually people hanging out in random spots and sometimes there will be just regular looking items either on the floor or on a countertop. This is the best image I could generate that replicates the room I can envision most. Let me know if you recognize this place! I’ve “been in” this exact room at least 4 times now. (Note: the room in the generated image is a bit more “zoomed in” than the one I see in my dreams. The dream house is very large with big rooms.)
